description: Is this the seller's wallet, before my agent pays it? Fast payee check before an agent pays. Send the resource URL and the payment terms you are about to sign: payee wallet, network and amount. Paddock answers from its daily settlement record in one call, with no live probe, and returns pass, warn, fail or unknown. Only fail recommends blocking. Free without a key up to 25 checks a day, or 1000 a day with a free key. For a full check against the seller's live payment terms, use verify_before_pay. Past the free limits, $0.01 per call over x402.

api_key.description: Paddock API key. A free key (pk_free_) is enough for this tool — POST an email to paddock.finance/api/keys/free to get one. Builder/Pro Agent keys also work.

asset.description: Token address. Echoed back, not checked

network.description: CAIP-2 or x402 friendly name, e.g. eip155:8453, base, solana

pay_to.description: The payee wallet from the payment requirements

url.description: The resource URL the agent is about to pay
